name: Lemon chickpea bowls
description: Crispy chickpeas, cool cucumber, and a bright lemon-herb dressing make a satisfying bowl for any day.
imageAlt: Lemon chickpea bowls with cucumber, tomatoes, rice, and lemon-herb dressing
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Pat the chickpeas dry, toss with olive oil, salt, and pepper, then roast for 20 minutes until crisp.
Stir the yogurt with lemon juice, dill, a pinch of salt, and a splash of water until spoonable.
Divide the warm rice, cucumber, and tomatoes between bowls. Add the chickpeas and finish with the lemon-herb dressing.

name: Tomato butter beans
description: Creamy beans simmered in garlicky tomato sauce with wilted greens and plenty of crusty bread.
imageAlt: Creamy tomato butter beans with wilted greens and crusty bread
steps: Warm the olive oil in a deep skillet over medium heat. Add the garlic and smoked paprika and stir for 30 seconds.
Pour in the tomatoes and broth. Add the beans, season with salt and pepper, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Fold in the spinach until just wilted. Serve warm with toasted crusty bread.

name: Ginger salmon tray
description: A sweet-savory ginger glaze brings salmon, broccoli, and fluffy rice together with barely any cleanup.
imageAlt: Ginger-glazed salmon with broccoli and rice
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Whisk together the ginger, soy sauce, honey, and rice vinegar.
Arrange the salmon and broccoli on a lined sheet pan. Spoon the glaze over the salmon and roast for 12–15 minutes, until the fish flakes easily.
Serve over warm rice and spoon any pan juices over the top. Finish with sesame seeds.

name: Green goddess toast
description: A creamy herby spread, ripe avocado, and crunchy seeds turn a quick breakfast into a little ritual.
imageAlt: Sourdough toast with green herb spread, avocado, and pumpkin seeds
steps: Toast the sourdough until golden and crisp.
Mash the cottage cheese with parsley, chives, lemon juice, and a pinch of salt. Spread generously over the toast.
Slice the avocado over each piece. Scatter with pumpkin seeds, chili flakes, and a little black pepper.

name: Crispy chicken couscous
description: Golden spiced chicken, fluffy couscous, and a quick cucumber salad make a fresh, filling supper.
imageAlt: Spiced chicken with couscous, cucumber salad, and lemon yogurt
steps: Rub the chicken with cumin, coriander, olive oil, salt, and pepper. Sear in a hot skillet for 5–6 minutes per side, until the thickest part reaches 165°F (74°C).
Put the couscous in a bowl with a pinch of salt. Pour over 1 cup of boiling water, cover for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork and lemon zest.
Mix the yogurt with lemon juice. Slice the cucumber and serve everything together with the lemon yogurt.

name: Peach oat crumble
description: Juicy peaches bake under a crisp, cinnamon-scented oat topping for a simple dessert to share.
imageAlt: Warm peach crumble with a crisp oat topping and vanilla yogurt
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Toss the sliced peaches with lemon juice and spread in a small baking dish.
Rub the oats, flour, brown sugar, cinnamon, and cold butter together with your fingertips until crumbly. Scatter over the peaches.
Bake for 25 minutes until bubbling and golden. Let rest for 5 minutes and serve with vanilla yogurt.

name: Griot plate with pikliz
description: Citrus-marinated griot, golden bannann peze, and bright pikliz make a celebratory Haitian plate.
imageAlt: Haitian griot with golden bannann peze and pikliz cabbage slaw

ingredients.name: Sour orange juice or orange-lime juice

steps: Toss the pork with citrus juice, epis, garlic, thyme, salt, and pepper. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour.
Add the pork and marinade to a pot with 1 cup of water. Cover and simmer gently until fork-tender, about 45–55 minutes. Uncover and cook until the liquid evaporates.
Shallow-fry the pork in a little oil, turning until crisp and deeply browned. Drain on a rack.
Peel and cut the plantains into thick pieces. Fry at 350°F (175°C) until lightly golden, flatten each piece, then fry again until crisp. Serve with pikliz.

name: Diri ak djon djon with chicken
description: Earthy black mushroom rice with tender epis-seasoned chicken and a lively spoonful of pikliz.
imageAlt: Haitian black djon djon rice with lima beans, roast chicken, and pikliz
steps: Soak the djon djon in 3 cups of hot water for 20 minutes. Strain and reserve the dark mushroom broth; discard any grit.
Season the chicken with half the epis, salt, and pepper. Brown in a covered pot with a little oil, then add a splash of water and cook until the thickest part reaches 165°F (74°C). Set aside.

In the same pot, soften the remaining epis and garlic. Stir in the rice and lima beans, then add the mushroom broth and thyme. Bring to a boil, cover, and cook on low until the rice is tender, 18–22 minutes.
Rest the rice covered for 5 minutes, fluff with a fork, and serve with the chicken and pikliz.

name: Tassot beef with plantains
description: Tender citrus-seasoned beef is browned until crisp and served with twice-fried plantains and pikliz.
imageAlt: Haitian tassot beef with golden plantains, pikliz, and lime

ingredients.name: Beef chuck or stew meat, cubed

steps: Mix the beef with citrus juice, epis, garlic, thyme, salt, and pepper. Cover and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Transfer the beef and marinade to a pot with 1 cup of water. Cover and simmer gently until tender, about 50–60 minutes. Remove the beef and pat dry.
Sear the beef in a hot skillet with oil, turning until browned and crisp around the edges.
Cut peeled plantains into thick pieces and fry at 350°F (175°C) until lightly golden. Flatten each piece and fry again until crisp. Serve with the beef and pikliz.

name: Peach oat breakfast cups
description: Soft peaches, yogurt, and oats come together in a cool breakfast cup in minutes.
imageAlt: Peaches and oats served in a small bowl
steps: Divide the yogurt between two bowls or jars.
Add oats and sliced peaches, then finish with pumpkin seeds and a little honey.
Eat right away, or cover and chill until breakfast.

name: Quick avocado toast
description: A simple toast with creamy avocado and lemon for a ten-minute morning.
imageAlt: Avocado toast with green herbs and seeds
steps: Toast the sourdough until crisp.
Mash the avocado with lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Spread over the toast and scatter with pumpkin seeds and black pepper.

name: Savory chickpea breakfast bowls
description: Warm chickpeas, rice, and crisp vegetables make a filling morning bowl when there is more time.
imageAlt: Chickpea and rice bowls with vegetables
steps: Warm the rice and chickpeas in a skillet with olive oil for a few minutes.
Chop the tomatoes and cucumber while the chickpeas heat.
Divide everything between bowls and finish with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
